alex: Quick Q — short quarterly OKR check on infra-runtime v3 milestone. What shipped vs slipped? Owners + any CRs blocking? cc @pm_jules :wave:
pm_jules: TL;DR: Shipped: autoscale patch, canary routing tweak. Slipped: prefix-dedup cache (perf regression), and rollout gating tests. Owners: @devon on dedup fix, @maria on rollout docs. No customer-impacting outages yet.
devon: I have a draft PR: github.com/redwood/infra/pull/482 — needs review from eng-runtime. CI failing on perf benchmark, investigating. ping @anita for code review.
anita: On it. Saw one flaky test `kv_cache_test::eviction_order` — I'll add a comment on the PR and kick a full CI run. Should be able to review today :hourglass: 
alex: Perf test failure snippet:
```
assert latency_ms.mean() < 100
// observed 145ms on long-tail cases
```
maria: Next steps: 1) prioritize dedup fix (devon+anita pairing), 2) update OKR doc with ship/slip, 3) notify Dedicated customers if rollout delays. I'll take #2 and draft the customer note.
sam_support: Will prepare a short comms template and standby for approvals. Also can triage incoming tickets if latency spikes.
infra-bot: deploy-check: canary routing bumped to v3.2.1 on staging — smoke tests passed :white_check_mark: 
devon: Updated PR with CI logs and a perf-optimized path. Marked as WIP until CR + perf numbers improve. @anita re-requesting review.
anita: Reviewed, left two small nits and one suggestion to change batching window to 8ms. Re-ran perf locally — now stable at ~95ms tail. :thumbsup: 
pm_jules: Great. Action list: devon finish PR + merge after anita's nits, maria update OKR doc (I'll review), sam prep comms draft, alex schedule 30m post-merge monitoring sync tomorrow 10am. If anything slips again, escalate and run blameless postmortem.
alex: Thanks everyone. Ping here when PR merged and when comms drafted. :eyes:
